newsitem.title: USA: Conseco on track to meet or beat 1997 estimate.
newsitem.headline: Conseco on track to meet or beat 1997 estimate.

text.p: Conseco Inc said it is on track to equal or exceed the First Call consensus analysts' estimate of $2.67 of operating earnings per share in 1997, up about 40 percent over the $1.89 reported in 1996.
The insurer reported second-quarter 1997 operating earnings of $136.6 million, up 154 percent over a year ago.
Operating earnings per fully diluted share were $0.64 on the quarter, up 45 percent over a year ago.
"We are very pleased with these results," said Conseco chairman Stephen Hilbert.

"Upon completion of the Colonial Penn acquisition, Conseco will have approximately $34 billion of investments under management, $32 billion of assets on its own balance sheet, $7.6 billion of annual premiums and revenues, $9.5 billion of equity market capitalization, and a book value of more than $19.00 per share," Hilbert said.

"With a debt/capital ratio below our 35 percent target, and more than $800 million of expected EBIT cash flow, we have the balance sheet flexibility we need in order to pursue the most profitable opportunities we can find," he added.
